The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 31 epochs. That removes the yield anyone would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 3 epochs.
